newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan paves way for futures brokerage expansion.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan paves way for futures brokerage expansion.

text.p: Taiwan's Securities and Exchange Commission has eased rules for futures brokerages planning to expand, the SEC said on Friday.
The companies would be able to set up new branches with a capital of T$15 million each and a minimum of three dealers, down from T$50 million and five dealers previously, the SEC said in a statement.
"The SEC's revision allows us to set up branches with less money and personnel," an executive at Taiwan's Grand Cathay Futures Corp said.
The Grand Cathay executive said the SEC's decision would help expand Taiwan's futures market as the island prepares for its own futures exchange.
Taiwan plans to set up a futures exchange next year.
